details: U.S. spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds recorded $635.6 million in net outflows on Thursday, October 23, reversing previous days of inflows and pushing October's net flows negative by approximately $176 million. BlackRock's IBIT and Fidelity's FBTC were among those with significant withdrawals.
title: US Spot Bitcoin ETFs See Significant $635M Outflows

details: Bloomberg Intelligence strategist Mike McGlone warns that Bitcoin could plunge to $10,000 if the S&P 500 experiences a sustained 20% correction. He suggests that Bitcoin's increased mainstream adoption through ETFs exposes it more to traditional market risks, tighter monetary policy, and broader sell-offs.
title: Bloomberg Analyst Warns Bitcoin Could Drop to $10K if S&P 500 Falls 20%

details: Senator Richard Blumenthal is seeking records from stablecoin issuer Tether regarding alleged multimillion-dollar payments to Nxum, a consulting firm founded by Bo Hines, who served as a top White House crypto adviser. This investigation raises concerns about federal ethics and lobbying laws.
title: Sen. Blumenthal Probes Tether Over Payments to Ex-White House Crypto Adviser's Firm

details: Ethereum core developers have postponed the Glamsterdam upgrade for the Hoodi testnet, which was scheduled for October 26, 2026. The delay is due to ongoing investigations into how a proposed gas rule (EIP-8037) interacts with existing smart contracts, with security researchers identifying potential flaws.
title: Ethereum's Glamsterdam Testnet Fork Delayed Over Gas Security Flaws

details: The Initia layer-1 blockchain and its rollups were halted following a security incident on October 23, 2026. An attacker reportedly exploited a vulnerability to mint unauthorized tokens and transfer over $2.6 million in crypto assets to Ethereum.
title: Initia Network Halts Blockchain Due to Exploit, Unauthorized Token Minting

details: Block, formerly Square, has launched its first mass-consumer Bitcoin advertising campaign, "Bitcoin Does," targeting 60 million curious Americans. The campaign focuses on promoting Bitcoin's practical utility for buying, payments, and self-custody, rather than price speculation, highlighting it as a reliable alternative to traditional finance.
title: Block Launches National Bitcoin Ad Campaign for Practical Use

details: HSBC has begun rolling out its first stablecoin, RedCoin (RCHKD), pegged to the Hong Kong dollar, to users of its PayMe payment app in Hong Kong. Over 3.3 million PayMe users will gradually gain access to a stablecoin wallet within the app, with the token fully backed by high-quality liquid assets and regulated by the HKMA.
title: HSBC Rolls Out RedCoin HKD Stablecoin to PayMe Users in Hong Kong

details: The U.S. Internal Revenue Service (IRS) is preparing to overhaul its voluntary disclosure program, aiming to reduce penalties and accelerate the resolution of tax violations, including those involving cryptocurrencies. The revised program is expected to be introduced before December and will handle digital assets through existing disclosure procedures.
title: IRS to Reduce Penalties for Crypto Tax Violations Under New Disclosure Program

details: Six more companies, including Wells Fargo, Arm Holdings, and Intuit, are opposing the tokenization of their shares on a new trading platform backed by crypto exchange OKX and Intercontinental Exchange. These objections highlight ongoing challenges for stock tokenization, even after U.S. securities regulators approved such products.
title: Wells Fargo, Intuit Among Firms Objecting to Stock Tokenization Platform

details: Bitcoin Core has updated its security policy to fast-track patches and advisories for "easily discoverable" bugs, particularly in light of increasing AI-driven bug hunting. This new rule aims to provide node operators with fixes sooner for vulnerabilities that attackers could quickly find.
title: Bitcoin Core Fast-Tracks Fixes for Easily Discoverable Bugs as AI Threat Grows

details: Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) is rebranding its crypto fund as "a16z Frontier" and broadening its investment mandate to include artificial intelligence and other emerging technologies. While the name change is symbolic of a wider focus, the firm confirms it will continue to invest in crypto.
title: a16z Renames Crypto Fund to "Frontier," Expands to AI & Emerging Tech
